parity_reason: Each criterion differs by at most 1 and neither image has a critical defect, but the totals are 23 for A and 20 for B. That 3-point gap is more than the allowed 1, so parity is false.

reference.summary: A cartoon monkey clings to the trunk of a large apple tree full of red apples and reaches up toward an apple, which clearly answers the prompt.

defects.what: The monkey's lower leg and gripping limb blend into the trunk, so it is hard to tell which limb wraps the trunk and where the foot is anchored
defects.where: the monkey's left side and lower body against the trunk
defects.expected: Each limb should clearly read as an arm or a leg gripping the trunk, with a visible hand or foot holding on

defects.what: Thin dark vertical lines on the trunk look like stray strokes and do not clearly read as bark or as a limb outline
defects.where: the trunk behind the monkey's left leg
defects.expected: Trunk marks should read clearly as bark texture or be part of a clearly shaped limb

defects.what: The raised hand sits next to an apple without clearly grasping it, so it is unclear whether the monkey is holding the apple or a branch
defects.where: the monkey's raised right hand under the canopy
defects.expected: The hand should clearly grip either an apple or a branch

attempt.summary: A cartoon monkey hangs by both arms from the branches of an apple tree with its legs dangling, which reads more as hanging than climbing but still fits the prompt.

defects.what: The monkey hangs from the branches with its legs dangling in the air instead of climbing, so the climbing action is weak
defects.where: the monkey's legs and overall pose
defects.expected: The monkey should look like it is actively climbing, with its feet or legs gripping the trunk or a branch

defects.what: The feet float in front of the trunk without touching anything
defects.expected: The feet should press against or grip the trunk

defects.what: The monkey's ears are barely visible, so the head reads less clearly as a monkey's
defects.where: the sides of the monkey's head
defects.expected: Clearly visible rounded ears on either side of the head

defects.what: The tree canopy and monkey take up a fairly small central area, leaving a lot of empty sky
defects.where: the overall framing, especially the lower half and sides
defects.expected: The tree and monkey should fill more of the frame so the main subject has more presence
